Different Spokes Jersey Ride

San Francisco, CA · Castro · Road

LGBTQ+

Different Spokes Jersey Ride is a road group ride in San Francisco, CA. It rolls second Saturday of the month at 9:00 am from Peet's Coffee, Castro (16th and Market). About 24 or 48 miles, b/C (48-mile option), A/C (24-mile option).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: b/C (48-mile option), A/C (24-mile option). It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Different Spokes Jersey Ride group ride

The monthly club ride of the Bay Area's LGBTQ+ cycling club. Two groups, one from the Castro (48 miles) and one from Mike's Bikes in Sausalito (24 miles), meet in Tiburon for lunch. Straight friends are welcome too. Guests can ride three times before joining.
